about_short_description.short_description: MoPub is a mobile monetization platform that helps publishers drive more revenue from advertising and mobile transactions.

product.name: Unified Auction
product.description: A platform for maximizing app real estate revenue by allowing multiple in-app bidders and networks to compete.

product.name: Ad Formats
product.description: Supports various in-app ad formats including native, interstitial, rewarded, playable, rich media, MREC, and banner display to enhance revenue opportunities.

product.name: 360° Growth
product.description: Enables reinvestment of ad revenues into user acquisition to drive app growth, utilizing AppLovin’s AppDiscovery engine.

product.name: Reporting Tools
product.description: Provides a suite of tools for actionable insights on ad performance, revenue, and monetization strategy optimization through a comprehensive dashboard.

product.name: A/B Testing
product.description: Facilitates testing of monetization strategies, including demand partners, ad configurations, and user segments, to identify revenue improvement opportunities.

product.name: Mediation Management Tools
product.description: Automates the update of network CPMs and optimizes mediation for revenue enhancement without manual intervention.
